rationale: Because the Chief is in the majority and articulated the controlling “specific, articulable facts”/scope-and-duration cabining, he is most likely to keep the coalition together by writing narrowly. The four-justice minority is ideologically cross-cutting but unified on a probable-cause floor, making at least one principal dissent (likely Thomas or Gorsuch) and a possible second dissent (Sotomayor) plausible, with some majority concurrences to emphasize limits and anti-pretext safeguards.
